Monthly upkeep for {{MONTH}}, opened automatically on the 1st. Nothing here runs by itself: the provider check needs the maintainer's own keys and is started by hand. Tick what was done and note the outcome below, so this issue is the record of the month.

### Cloud providers and their models

- [ ] Run the provider check and go through what differs from the model catalog: models that are new or gone, reasoning values that are refused or newly accepted, audio formats, real-time
- [ ] Vendor retirement pages: OpenAI deprecations, Scaleway's end-of-life table
- [ ] Lists kept by hand because the vendor has no usable model list: ElevenLabs, AssemblyAI, Deepgram
- [ ] Catalog changes committed one by one, each with its reason; wiki provider pages updated

### On-device models

- [ ] Look for new speech models that could run on a phone (sherpa-onnx releases, Hugging Face, new Whisper, Parakeet, Canary or SenseVoice builds): size, languages, speed, licence
- [ ] Anything worth testing is listed here with a link
